commit_message: Fix ADR0155 legacy-local default regression test
pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation v4
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0155 managed llama.cpp integration on latest main. This follow-up aligns the legacy external-local regression test with the measured-default policy: existing external Local remains the ordinary default until representative WindowsNative versus Wsl2Linux characterization selects a Managed Local product default. The test also verifies the legacy endpoint is preserved.
